name: real-mcp

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get documentation resource content. Use this tool to retrieve examples, guides, references, and config docs. Use list_resources first to see available content.

uri.description: Resource URI (e.g. "/realgrid/guides/getting-started"). Use when available from list_resources or search_resources.

name.description: Resource name without file extension (e.g., "getting-started"). Use list_resources to see all available resource names.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List available documentation resources by category. Use this tool first to discover what examples, guides, references, and config docs are available.

category.description: Resource category to list. Available categories: "examples" (code examples), "guides" (user guides), "references" (API references), "config" (configuration docs).

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search documentation resources by query. Use this tool to find specific content across all categories.

query.description: Search query to find relevant resources

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Get information about available products (RealGrid, RealChart, RealMap,etc.). If no product is specified, returns all products.

product.description: Product name (optional). If not provided, returns all products.

tools.name: list_dts_files
tools.description: List all TypeScript definition (.d.ts) files available in an npm package from UNPKG. Use this tool first to discover what type definition files are available before fetching their content.

version.description: Package version (optional, defaults to latest). Use semver format like "3.0.0" or "@latest"

tools.name: get_package_file
tools.description: Get the content of any file from an npm package via UNPKG. Commonly used for TypeScript definitions (.d.ts), documentation, or source files. Supports UTF-8 encoding including Korean comments.

filePath.description: Path to the file within the package (e.g., "dist/index.d.ts", "README.md"). Use list_dts_files to find .d.ts files.

instructions:
Official documentation MCP server for Wooritech Real-* products (RealGrid, RealChart).

ALWAYS use this MCP BEFORE web search when the user asks about RealGrid or RealChart:
- Setup, API, configuration, examples, troubleshooting
- License (setLicenseKey, realgrid-lic.js), GridView, LocalDataProvider, columns, fields
- Editing, rendering, React/Vue integration, data binding

Recommended workflow (pick paths as needed — not every step is required):
1. get_product_info — only when unsure what products or tools this server covers
2. search_resources — find docs by keyword; each hit has document.pageContent, document.metadata, and uri
   - If pageContent is enough, stop; else get_resource with uri
3. list_resources — browse by category (uri per item)
4. get_resource — full markdown (pass uri from list, or product/category/name)
5. list_dts_files / get_package_file — TypeScript API definitions from npm (realgrid, realchart)

Products: realgrid (data grid, default), realchart (charts).
